findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Need an interface and the system behind it?" → 3 lines (8 words, 43.2px, a paragraph set above 36px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 1440px: "I build the screen and the systems behin…" → 7 lines at 31px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 31px (2.2vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.
Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.5:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: The margins differ: 8px on the left, 20px on the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.
